title: feat(types): the six plugin-designer node types get zod arms; variables / parameters leave the TS face (objectui#10859 batch 7)
body:
Part of #10859
Clause-②: yes

Batch 7 of objectui#10859, claim `5943202824` (seat `domain:ui#2`, session `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42`): the six `@object-ui/plugin-designer` node types (`page-designer`, `data-model-designer`, `process-designer`, `report-designer`, `object-manager`, `field-designer`) get zod arms in a new `packages/types/src/zod/designer.zod.ts`, after the two zero-read members ruling `5861220023` names are settled. `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` falls 72 → 66.

## The settlement first: the premise, measured before any edit

The claim retires `ProcessDesignerSchema.variables` and `ReportDesignerSchema.parameters` from the TypeScript face only if, at base, neither has a reader in any package's non-test source AND neither has a producer beyond its own declaration docblock. Both halves held for both members (base `9547063da`, which is `138ad4554e` plus PR objectui#11407, a `packages/types` list change that touches none of these files):

| half | instrument | `variables` | `parameters` | control (a member that IS read) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| reader, component | `git grep -n -w` over `packages/plugin-designer/` | 0 hits | 0 hits | `showMinimap` in `ProcessDesigner.tsx`: 2; `showPropertyPanel` in `ReportDesigner.tsx`: 4 |
| reader, any package | every TS consumer of the two types (`git grep` for either type name) | only `designer.ts`, the `index.ts` re-export and one `types` test (its fixtures author neither) | same | the same grep finds the `content-channel-remeasure-9256` fixtures |
| reader, by node type | every tracked file naming `process-designer` / `report-designer` | six files: the declaration, the registration, `known-schema-types.ts`, one changeset (prose), two tests; none reads the key | same | — |
| reader, at runtime | real `SchemaRenderer` + real registry (`import '../index'`), only the one key varied (temp probe, not committed) | markup identical with and without an authored `variables` array | identical with and without `parameters` | `processName` / `reportName` changed: markup differs |
| producer | docs (`content/docs`, the plugin README), examples, schema-catalog, apps, skills, CHANGELOGs; and objectstack `fbcc05f` | none | none | objectstack: `object-gantt` hits 14 files |

The generic readers of a `variables` key (the `page` renderer's `schema.variables`, `react-page`) read it off their own node types only. None of the six designer components spreads a rest prop onward (`grep` for a props/rest spread in the six files: exit 1), so a key a component does not destructure is dropped.

**How they were retired.** Removed outright from the TypeScript face, not tombstoned: neither prong of the retire-vs-remove discriminator `complex.ts` states holds (no live replacement key, and nothing taught the key as working). Each removal leaves a block comment where the member stood saying why. The arms do not declare them either, so neither face declares them now. Consequence, stated in the changeset: the `BaseSchema` index signature still admits either key at any value on the TypeScript face, `safeValidateSchema` passes it through as it does any undeclared key, and the strict authoring face refuses it by name (pinned).

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/zod/designer.zod.ts` (new).** The six node arms, each `BaseSchema.extend` with its `type` literal and the members of its TypeScript declaration, plus the record mirrors those members hold: `DesignerPositionSchema`, `DesignerCanvasConfigSchema`, `DesignerComponentSchema` (recursive through `children`, built as `TreeNodeSchema` is: a `z.lazy` annotated with the declaration as both type arguments), `DesignerPaletteItemSchema`, `DesignerPaletteCategorySchema`, `DataModelFieldSchema`, `DataModelEntitySchema`, `DataModelRelationshipSchema`, `BPMNNodeSchema`, `BPMNEdgeSchema`, `ReportDesignerElementSchema`, `ReportDesignerSectionSchema`, `ObjectDefinitionRelationshipSchema`, `ObjectDefinitionSchema`, `DesignerFieldOptionSchema`, `DesignerValidationRuleSchema`, `DesignerFieldDefinitionSchema`. The field designer's `type` is `z.enum(DESIGNER_FIELD_TYPES)`, read from `designer.ts` (the `complex.zod.ts` precedent imports `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPES` the same way). Each arm refuses `body` / `children` by name through `neitherContentChannelGuidance` (objectui#9256 family D; the TypeScript twins already carry `?: never`). No `.default()`. `DesignerUnionSchema` is the category union (named so because `DesignerComponentSchema` is the canvas component's mirror; the `ReportUnionSchema` precedent).
- **`index.zod.ts`.** The barrel exports, and `DesignerUnionSchema` in `AnyComponentSchema`'s arm list.
- **`designer.ts`.** The two removals, and the six `children` docblocks no longer say "This declaration has no zod mirror, so this face is the only gate" (the sentence this change made false).
- **Four other zero-read node members, NOT mirrored, NOT retired.** Measured the same way (props declared on the component, never used; the runtime probe drew identical markup with and without each, with a lit control per type): `DataModelDesignerSchema.autoLayout`, `ProcessDesignerSchema.version` and `.lanes` (destructured into an unused `_lanes`), `ReportDesignerSchema.previewMode`. Per the claim they stay on the TypeScript face, the arms omit them, and they are recorded for the seat (below). Every other node member is mirrored, and each has a reader in its component (destructured and used; counts in the report).
- **Census (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`).** 22 `MIRRORS` / `Declared` pairs (`EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 170 → 192); `EXCLUSIONS` rows for `DesignerComponentSchema` (recursive) and `DesignerUnionSchema` (a union); `DesignerComponentSchema` joins `RECURSION_BREAKING_MIRRORS`; three `UnmirroredDeclared` entries (four keys) for the zero-read members, each worded as unmirrored BY DECISION for the seat to rule, not mirroring debt; the header figures and the history sentence each pinned figure keeps. The type-level ledgers (`KnownDrift`, `WiderThanDeclared`, `MirroredUndeclared`) needed no row: every mirrored member's type equals its declaration's.
- **Ratchet (`registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`).** `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 72 → 66 and one row naming the six keys. Only the pin's own docblock, the constant and the new row are touched.
- **New pin `designer-zod-arms-10859.test.ts`.** Type-level: key sets and member types equal per pair, the four omissions named per arm, `DesignerComponentSchema` equal to `DesignerComponent` both ways, the settlement on both faces, an instrument-fires row. Runtime: a fully populated document of each type accepted on both faces; required-members-only accepted; `{ type }` alone claimed at `type` with the refusal at the required members; nested judgment (a bad BPMN node type, a field type outside `DESIGNER_FIELD_TYPES`, a bad `zIndex` two levels down the canvas tree); content channels refused by name; `variables` / `parameters` refused by the strict face as unrecognized keys.
- **`content-channel-remeasure-9256.test.ts`.** One dated note after the bullet that says the six have no zod mirror (a record of objectui#9256's tree, left as written), and the two inline comments that repeated it.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/README.md`.** A Designer Components group.
- **`.changeset/10859-designer-zod-arms.md`.** `@object-ui/types` minor, BREAKING (authoring) banner and migration text for the two retired members, `Clause-②: yes`.

## Red first, ablation, reverse validation (one-shot, not committed)

- **Base reading.** `safeValidateSchema({ type: KEY })` refused each of the six with one `invalid_union` at `type`; `timeline` accepted (the lit control).
- **Runtime ablation.** `DesignerUnionSchema` removed from `AnyComponentSchema`'s arm list through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP, plus the driver's own EXIT/INT/TERM trap): anchor 1 → 0, blob `a5093c84` → `eacad442`. The pin and the ratchet: Tests 38 failed | 24 passed (62); the ratchet read "refuses 72 registered bare key(s) at `type`; the pin is 66". Red: every pin row that reaches an arm through the root union, and the two ratchet rows. Green: the rows that read the arms directly (`DesignerUnionSchema` literals, the four omissions) and the ratchet's controls. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Vitest resolves `@object-ui/types/zod` to source, so no build sat between mutation and reading.
- **Type-level reverse validation.** `BPMNEdgeSchema.isDefault` retyped `z.string()`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2, TS2344 on the pin's key-type rows plus the census's `LedgerMismatch` / `WiderLedgerMismatch`. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- **The ledger the four keys belong in.** The three entries moved from `UnmirroredDeclared` into `KnownDrift`: `tsc` exit 2 (`LedgerMismatch`, and the unmirrored reconciliation naming the three pairs). `KnownDrift` holds keys a mirror declares and refuses; an absent key is `UnmirroredDeclared`'s. A first attempt at this leg was a no-op (its anchor sat inside its own replacement, so the tool refused and restored); it was re-run with a different anchor and the reading above is the second run.

## Serial

- Draft PR objectui#11069 also edits the ratchet file. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against its head `a11f7334`: one conflict, `packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts`, which this branch does not touch and which conflicts the same way between the base and that PR alone; the ratchet file auto-merges. Its hunks are untouched.
- Against `main` `cf38a6ce`: merged (no conflict).

## Acceptance notes

- **For the seat: nested record members with no reader.** The ruling's zero-read rule is applied to the six declarations' own members, as the claim scopes it. The record types under them are mirrored member for member as declared, as batch 1 mirrored `AIRecommendationItem.metadata` and `NLQueryResult.parsedQuery`. A source read (`.member` reads in the component that renders each record, plus `MetadataService` / `MetadataObjectsPage` / `MetadataFieldsPage` for the two shared ones; no runtime probe) finds no reader for: `DesignerCanvasConfig.backgroundColor`; `DesignerComponent.children` / `parentId` / `locked` / `visible` / `zIndex`; `DesignerPaletteCategory.icon`; `DesignerPaletteItem.icon` / `preview`; `DataModelField.unique` / `defaultValue` / `description`; `DataModelRelationship.sourceField` / `targetField` (both REQUIRED on the TypeScript face) / `onDelete` / `onUpdate`; `BPMNNode.properties` / `assignee` / `dueDate` / `script` / `serviceEndpoint`; `BPMNEdge.condition` / `isDefault`; `ReportDesignerElement.dataBinding` / `format`; `ReportDesignerSection.groupField` / `pageBreakBefore`; `ObjectDefinition.relationships` (so all of `ObjectDefinitionRelationship`); `DesignerFieldDefinition.validationRules` (so all of `DesignerValidationRule`). The question is in the report's `open_questions`.
- `data-model-designer`'s registration publishes `autoLayout` as an input while the component never reads it; `check:component-surface-parity` already reports it (base and head alike).
- No authored document of any of the six node types exists in objectui or objectstack today (only test fixtures), so this change moves no shipped document's verdict.

## Deviations

- The claim says the four other zero-read members are recorded as a pinned `KnownDrift`. Measured, the census cannot hold them there (the ledger leg above); they are in `UnmirroredDeclared`, the census's ledger for a declared key the mirror does not declare, worded as unmirrored by decision.
- The harness attribution reminder asks for a model-named commit trailer and a different PR footer. Per objectui's AGENTS.md and the role file, the commits carry the model-free pair and this body ends with the session-URL footer.
